facts.title: Vegetarian Breakfast Quesadillas with Scrambled Eggs, Spinach and Black Beans
ingredients: ½ cup melty shredded cheese (like cheddar or Monterey Jack), divided
1 tablespoon fresh lime juice (about 1 small lime, juiced)
2 tablespoons finely chopped white onion or radishes
3 packed tablespoons fresh cilantro (about 1 small handful)
1 small garlic clove, pressed or minced
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
